notes: No authorial page number appears at the top. The thin lower-left foliation is 51, matching H’s archive page for scan 52. The sheet continues with homéomorphismes universels and proposes faithfulness, and perhaps full faithfulness after localization, for an étale-topos construction. Its final example concerns exterior automorphisms and a structure à lacets. These are the author’s claims, not results checked in this reading. The marginal S de car. 0 ? is the author’s own question and belongs beside the given base S. The first base-topos letter is visibly X_et; the later one is S_et. The discrepancy is preserved rather than repaired from the surrounding scheme notation. The first functor shaft retains a dash/arrow doubt, and it has no left mapsto bar. In f,g:X=Y the two short unheaded strokes are transcribed literally as =, whereas the subsequent X_et-to-Y_et pair has visible arrowheads. The short sign after et is also literally =, consistent with the run’s unexpanded shorthand for même. The two réduits occupy different raised locations: the cancelled one is above finie–sur, and the live replacement has a leader after des schémas. The inserted f_et,g_et are readable, but their exact attachment is not fixed by a leader; the primary placement follows de topos, with a local uncertainty marker. The small ég/fg mark before isomorphes remains uncertain both in lettering and in deletion state. The subscript reading l.t.f. remains doubtful: the first-phase crop clips the bottom of f, so it cannot resolve the ending or final punctuation. The later full-formula audit box extends below the entire descender; the first-phase crop is not replaced. The opening les is clear, but suivants has a doubtful terminal s. The experimental verb and the verb after inserted re retain full word-ending alternatives; the clear en and raised prefix re are not conflated with those suffix doubts. Three autom occurrences and hom are dotless. Literal double ticks surround fait. The script E_K is an alphabet-only correction. The looped-l word lacets and the tiny accented à before it are retained without expansion or normalization. Provient is live despite retracing of its initial strokes. No final full stop is supplied after X. The line count covers 21 main baseline lines, five raised or marginal writing runs, and the foliation entry. No other page or return was inspected, and no mathematical proof check was performed.
